review: All required paired scenarios measured and retained. Candidate averages 107.2-129.1 FPS plain and 85.3-104.2 FPS with simultaneous abilities. High-resolution simultaneous abilities have 6.004-7.263 percent of frames above 16.7 ms: a documented performance limitation, not a claim of constant 60 FPS. One baseline 1080p plain repeat is much faster; all observations retained. Interrupted TAM-overlap run preserved separately. Steam Deck hardware not tested.
